name: Chrome hardback
description: A hardback in 16-bit chrome: the cover is filled with banded sky blues above a hard zigzag horizon and warm oranges below, with a dark outline, a light bevel edge, a cream page block for its extruded side and a white sparkle on the corner.
choices: The chrome logo’s banded fill, horizon, outline, bevel and extrusion are applied to a single book instead of lettering
No tile or border: the book stands on its own beside the wordmark
typography: DejaVu Sans Bold, plain outlined wordmark
